answer: Because your car is registered in Texas, Texas's duplicate title rules apply, not Georgia's; the rules follow the state that issued the title, even though you now live in Georgia. Since the car is paid off, we need that duplicate title before we can complete the purchase, but you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait. The help center doesn't say how long a Texas duplicate takes, so please contact a store for that.

facts.fact: the duplicate rules of the state that issued the title (Texas) apply
Texas titles are electronic, so for the sale you usually don't need a printed duplicate
a printed Texas duplicate takes 5 to 7 business days online
